title: Apify Review (2026)
intro: Apify is evaluated here as a web data / proxy collection platform — Apify is a web-scraping and automation platform built around Actors (ready-made or custom scrapers), compute units, storage, and Apify Proxy. Free includes $5 prepaid usage/month. Starter is $29/mo ($26 annual) with $29 prepaid usage; Scale $199 ($179 annual); Business $999 ($899 annual). Usage beyond prepaid is PAYG (compute units from $0.13–$0.20/CU). Residential proxy from $7–$8/GB depending on plan. Same web-data-collection cluster as Bright Data — different shape (Actor marketplace + compute, not enterprise proxy-first). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Apify when Actor-based scraping and automation is the job — not Bright Data proxy GB by default.
verdict: Choose Apify when Actor-based scraping and automation is the job — not Bright Data proxy GB by default. Compare Bright Data or Oxylabs for proxy-network estates; ScraperAPI for a simpler credit API. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Actor Store + console is approachable for developers; CU/proxy cost model is the learning curve. Not a lab test.
Actor-platform web scraping fits web-data-collection — different primary shape than Bright Data proxy estates.
Actors, schedules, storage, datasets, and proxy options form a deep scrape/automation loop.
SDKs, API, and automation connectors (incl. Zapier) for engineering workflows.
Business/Enterprise account paths exist; weaker ISO-first story than Oxylabs in public packaging.
Scale/Business + PAYG CU scales mid-market; enterprise is quote.
Free + $29 Starter is a sharp published floor for Actor work. Affiliate economics excluded.
Developer tooling and automation assist — scored as limited/supporting, not an LLM suite.
